name: Lucerne
tagline: A medieval lakeside town ringed by mountains
summary: Lucerne is postcard Switzerland: a covered wooden bridge, painted old-town squares and a lake framed by Mount Pilatus and Rigi. Cruise the lake on paddle steamers, ride the world's steepest cogwheel railway and visit the Lion Monument.
seasonNote: Summer is best for lakes and mountains. December has Christmas markets; Carnival (Fasnacht) is wild in February.
arrival: Trains from Zurich take about 45 minutes, and from Zurich Airport about an hour.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; boats, trains and cable cars for the mountains. The Swiss Travel Pass covers most.
cashTip: Cards and phone payments work almost everywhere; prices are in francs, and euros get a poor rate.
foodTip: Luzerner Chügelipastete vol-au-vent, fondue and rösti.
buyTip: Swiss watches, chocolate and army knives.
baseArea: Old town or by the lake

connections.note: Luzern–Interlaken Express over the Brünig Pass.
